prompt: Feature request: parseDuration(text) in src/duration.js only understands whole seconds and minutes. Extend it to the full spec. Units are ms, s, m, h, and d, case-insensitive. A duration is one or more number-unit parts written from larger to smaller units, optionally separated by spaces: '1h30m', '1h 30m', '2d 4h 5m 6s 7ms'. Numbers may be decimals ('1.5h'). A bare number with no unit means milliseconds ('250'). Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored. Everything else throws a RangeError, including '', '5x', '1h-', '-5s', 'h', '1m1h' (units out of order), and '1h1h' (unit repeated). Return the total in milliseconds.
